public_claim: A release contains only explicitly manifested public payload whose hashes, payload root and signed export commitments verify under the declared public trust policy.
does_not_claim: that private source code is public
that private repository history is disclosed
that absence of all conceptual overlap with private work can be proven
forbidden_categories: production logic not required by the public contract

verification_model.provenance: detached signature over release manifest hash, payload root and source commitment

rule: Only material required to specify, implement minimally, verify, attest, or release the public HEIMEL authority-to-consequence core may enter this repository.
